character.label: Isles of Discord: Pirate vs Unicorn

programs.brief: A menacing three-masted corsair flagship resting in the strait waters, with dark oak framing, broadside gunports, and a skull figurehead facing the enemy shore.
A grand white-quartz and amethyst monument of a celestial unicorn rearing on a stepped pedestal, holding a glowing horn aimed across the strait.
A fortified coastal cannon emplacement with log revetments, an iron gun carriage facing outward, and shot piles.
A magical defense wardstone composed of smooth quartz obelisks and glowing amethyst clusters, pulsing with arcane energy.
